metadata.title: Mid-Century Soul Album Cover Layout
useCases: Soul and R&B themed editorial layouts

retrievalProfile.description: A structured mid-century layout featuring a vertical red divider separating a left-aligned tracklist from a right-aligned artist name and framed photograph.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-column asymmetrical grid defined by a prominent vertical red stripe. The left section contains large display text and a staggered tracklist; the right section contains the primary artist name and a rectangular inset photograph of a performer in a studio setting.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical red line acts as the primary structural axis
Typography alternates between orange and light blue for rhythmic contrast
Inset photograph is anchored to the bottom right quadrant
Large display type is justified to the vertical divider
coreInvariants: Solid deep purple or navy background field
Heavy use of extra-condensed sans-serif typefaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is contained within a medium-shot rectangular frame in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical red stripe serves as the central anchor for all typographic alignment.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top-left title, move down the tracklist, cross the red line to the artist name, and settle on the photograph.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large blocks of solid dark color provide breathing room around the dense text blocks.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange and light sky blue for text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the vertical divider
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation accents against a low-value, dark background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic typeface family using color and scale to differentiate hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid deep purple background with a single vertical red stripe positioned one-third from the left. Place a rectangular photograph of a singer in the bottom right quadrant.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed sans-serif text. Align the left-side title and list to the right against the red stripe, alternating orange and blue colors. Align the right-side artist name to the left against the red stripe in white.

verificationChecks: Is the red line perfectly vertical?
Are the colors limited to purple, red, orange, blue, and white?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of the left column to the right column
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red line does not intersect the photograph.
Ensure the orange and blue text colors are legible against the purple.
Verify that the typography is strictly sans-serif.
Confirm the asymmetrical balance is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid dark field + vertical accent stripe + condensed sans-serif grid + inset rectangular photo.
